title: Six n8n AI agents replace 50+ hours of manual work a week across 20+ tools
summary: An agency built Consistent Minds an n8n 'automation factory' of six agents for lead generation, document intelligence, content, invoice processing and web scraping, each delivered in a one-week sprint.
agent_role: Agents run the recurring workflows across Slack, Gmail, CRM and accounting tools; the agency scoped and built each agent and the client team consumes the outputs.
outcome: Agents replace 50+ hours of manual work every week across 20+ integrated platforms (vendor-reported)
what_they_did: Agency Metizsoft built client Consistent Minds six n8n agents, each scoped, built, tested and deployed in a one-week sprint. The agents are an email and calendar assistant run from Slack or Teams, a document Q&A tool over manuals and contracts, a LinkedIn post creator, a Google Maps lead scraper, an invoice processor that pulls data from PDFs into AP workflows, and a scheduled scraper for JavaScript-heavy sites.
how_it_went: Metizsoft says the agents together replace 50+ hours of manual work a week across 20+ platforms. Per-agent claims include 5+ hours saved weekly by the email assistant and invoices processed in under 60 seconds. These are the vendor's own figures from its case study.
worth_knowing: This is a vendor marketing case study. Metizsoft says its metrics come from n8n execution logs and before-and-after time tracking, but they are not independently confirmed.
prompt: Help me build an n8n workflow that processes PDF invoices arriving in [email inbox or folder]. Extract vendor, invoice number, date, line items and total with an LLM, then add a row to [spreadsheet or accounting tool]. Flag low-confidence extractions for my review. First show me the node-by-node plan and a sample of the extracted fields from [test invoice]. Wait for my approval before connecting it to live accounts or pushing anything into payment workflows.
